setup: Not Docker; Windows + Linux. linux/setup.sh (or windows\START-HERE.bat) builds .venv, installs torch from cu128 index (aarch64: cu130), installs upstream exllamav3 v1.4.4 (prebuilt wheel from turboderp-org/exllamav3 release matched by tools/wheels.py, else source build of git+https://github.com/turboderp-org/exllamav3.git@v1.4.4; kit refuses any other engine version), aiohttp, huggingface_hub; tools/profiles.py picks quant/context from VRAM and writes .env; tools/downloader.py fetches HF_TARGET_REPO@HF_REVISION. linux/start.sh then execs the server and starts DeepSeek Harness (npx, Node 22.19+) on 127.0.0.1:3080 unless UI=no. Requires Python 3.11+, driver 570+, CC 7.5+.
